title: 君子于役
titleEn: My Husband Is Away on Service
author: 佚名（《诗经·王风》）
authorEn: Anonymous (Book of Songs, Airs of Wang)
intro: At dusk the hens go back to their roost and the cattle come down the hill — everything comes home except her husband, sent far away on the king’s service. One of the earliest and gentlest poems of a wife missing her man.
analysis: 这首诗是一位农家妻子的歌。丈夫被派去服役（打仗或修工事），不知道什么时候能回来。她没有写自己怎么哭，只写了黄昏的一个画面：鸡回到墙洞里的窝，太阳落下去，牛羊从山坡上走下来。天黑了，连鸡和牛羊都回家了，只有丈夫还在远方——这种用眼前景物衬托心情的写法，叫“借景抒情”，后来“日暮怀人”成了中国诗歌里常见的主题。两章几乎一样，这是民歌“重章叠句”的特点，但结尾变了：第一章说“怎么能不想他”，第二章说“只求他别挨饿受渴”。从盼他回来，到只盼他平安，期望越来越小，感情反而越来越深，非常动人。
analysisEn: This is a farm wife’s song. Her husband has been sent away on state service — fighting or building — and no one knows when he will return. She never tells us she is crying. Instead she paints one scene at dusk: the hens settle into their nests in the wall, the sun goes down, and the sheep and cattle come down the hillside. As night falls, even the animals are home; only he is still out there. Letting a scene carry the feeling like this is called “expressing feeling through scenery” (借景抒情), and “thinking of a loved one at sunset” became a lasting theme in Chinese poetry. The two stanzas are almost the same — repetition is typical of folk songs — but the endings change. First she says, “How can I not miss him?” Then, after time has passed beyond counting, she says only, “I just hope he isn’t hungry or thirsty.” Her hopes have shrunk from his return to his mere survival, and that small wish says more about her love than any cry of grief could.
background: The Book of Songs gathers 305 songs from roughly the 11th to the 6th century BC. This one comes from the “Airs of Wang” (王风), songs from the region around the Eastern Zhou capital near present-day Luoyang, a time when ordinary men were often sent away on long military or labour service.
pronunciation: 埘 shí；佸 huó；桀 jié（指鸡栖息的木桩）；括 kuò；曷 hé；苟 gǒu；期 qī。“于役”的“役”读 yì。
version: 采用通行的《毛诗》文本，全诗两章，每章八句，网站按意思排成每章三行。

lines.zh: 君子于役，不知其期，曷至哉？
lines.rhythm: 君子/于役，不知/其期，曷/至哉
lines.py: jūn zǐ yú yì, bù zhī qí qī, hé zhì zāi
lines.lit: My husband is away on service; I do not know for how long. When will he arrive?
lines.en: My man is off on the king’s service, and no one can tell me for how long. When will he be home?
lines.tts: 君子于役，不知其期，何至哉？

lines.zh: 鸡栖于埘，日之夕矣，羊牛下来。
lines.rhythm: 鸡栖/于埘，日之/夕矣，羊牛/下来
lines.py: jī qī yú shí, rì zhī xī yǐ, yáng niú xià lái
lines.lit: The chickens roost in their wall-nests; the day has reached dusk; the sheep and cattle come down.
lines.en: The hens settle into their nests in the wall, the day is fading, the sheep and cattle come down the hill.
lines.tts: 鸡栖于时，日之夕矣，羊牛下来。

lines.py: jūn zǐ yú yì, rú zhī hé wù sī
lines.lit: My husband is away on service — how can I not think of him!
lines.en: My man is far away — how could I not miss him?

lines.zh: 君子于役，不日不月，曷其有佸？
lines.rhythm: 君子/于役，不日/不月，曷其/有佸
lines.py: jūn zǐ yú yì, bù rì bù yuè, hé qí yǒu huó
lines.lit: My husband is away on service, not for days, not for months. When will we meet again?
lines.en: My man is off on service, too long to count in days or months. When will we be together again?
lines.tts: 君子于役，不日不月，何其有活？

lines.zh: 鸡栖于桀，日之夕矣，羊牛下括。
lines.rhythm: 鸡栖/于桀，日之/夕矣，羊牛/下括
lines.py: jī qī yú jié, rì zhī xī yǐ, yáng niú xià kuò
lines.lit: The chickens roost on their perches; the day has reached dusk; the sheep and cattle come down and gather.
lines.en: The hens hop onto their perches, the day is fading, the sheep and cattle come down and crowd into the pen.

lines.py: jūn zǐ yú yì, gǒu wú jī kě
lines.lit: My husband is away on service — may he at least not be hungry or thirsty!
lines.en: My man is far away — I only hope he is not hungry, not thirsty.

words.note: 妻子对丈夫的尊称；今天“君子”指品德好的人。

words.en: to be away on state service (war or labour)
words.note: 役：服役，现代汉语“服兵役”。
古汉语疑问词，相当于“何时”“何”。

words.en: a hen’s nest dug into a wall
the day has come to evening

words.note: 古义；今天“桀”多见于人名“夏桀”。
现代汉语“包括”“概括”都有聚合的意思。
今天见于“苟且”“一丝不苟”。

imagery.name: 夕阳
imagery.zh: “日之夕矣”：黄昏是一家人团聚的时候，丈夫却不在，思念最浓。
imagery.en: Dusk is when families gather — and the hour she misses him most.

imagery.name: 牛羊
imagery.zh: 鸡回窝、牛羊归圈，连牲畜都回家了，反衬丈夫迟迟不归。
imagery.en: Even the hens and cattle come home at nightfall, which makes his absence all the sharper.
